description: HTML file for a database viewer interface, displaying databases and their tables, along with user interactions such as fetching and displaying data from those tables.

classes.name: DatabaseViewer
classes.description: Class handling the primary functionalities and interactions for the database viewer interface.

methods.name: loadDatabases()
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases()
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the viewer.

methods.name: toggleDatabase(db)
methods.description: Handles the display of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables(db)
methods.description: Fetches and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData(db, tableName)
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in the database.

methods.name: renderTable(container, data)
methods.description: Renders a data table in the content area.

methods.name: expandCell(element)
methods.description: Expands or collapses a table cell to show full content.
